observations: The runtime did not give me a task identity, so task is null.

I opened assets/panels/06-2.png, vision-cast.png and page-06.png, and read artwork-r2-06-2.json. A grep of the request shows the 06-2 panel hash is ffb8ceb5..., the same as the earlier request, so the art is unchanged and only the lettering and protected region changed. I checked this request's target, file list and hash with grep. I did not read every line of the request; I took the shared page-06 script from the full 06-1 request.

Identity: the specialist matches vision-cast.png. He has greying temples, thin rimless rectangular glasses, bushy salt-and-pepper brows, a neat grey moustache, a long face with smile lines, a light grey blazer over a pale blue shirt, a brown belt and a stethoscope around his neck.
Hands: his right hand (viewer-left) is held out palm-up with five fingers, in a welcoming gesture. His left hand hangs at his side, empty. This matches production.hands.specialist.

Vision framing: a soft pale-blue rounded-rectangle vignette, a light airy palette, a modern glass clinic, and three small clinic silhouettes in the sky linked by white dotted lines. There is no text or logo in the art.

Earlier issue (caption hid the welcoming hand): resolved. The protected region [672,262,74,54] matches where the hand is (my estimate is page x 678-739, y 267-313). On page-06.png the open hand and forearm are fully visible at about page x 680-740, y 270-310, just above the narration box, which now starts at about y 322 and spans the bottom band. The WELBUK VISION label at the top-left covers part of the middle clinic silhouette, but the left and right silhouettes and the dotted links stay readable.
On the composed page the narration box covers the specialist's relaxed left hand and the clinic entrance steps. That hand is not key acting, so I accept it.
Acting: a broad, warm smile as he gestures toward the clinic fits 'welcomes the viewer, hopeful'.
